purpose: First Comfy Cloud asset experiment for Water Before the Crossing
scope: One static exterior housing for a communal water pump

visual_direction.character: Readable, practical, carefully repaired, modest wear
visual_direction.presentation: Isolated object, neutral background, clear silhouette, even illumination

avoid: Tiny decorative geometry that obscures the shape
Baked-in water spray or dramatic shadows
authorization_scope: One native Comfy Cloud concept image within the agreed experiment; further generations and mesh production remain separate steps
concept_review: Readable housing, service panel, separated fittings, and lever socket
Maintenance and repairs express care; palette fits the lakeside village
Simple silhouette and unobstructed three-quarter view suitable as a modeling reference
